verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect. The new test pins all three current module-level compiled worker issue head-ref regexes to the canonical byte string, exercises meaningful admission boundaries, AST-discovers undeclared and stale literal re.compile copies within its documented scope, includes an anti-vacuity assertion, and verifies unconditional CI wiring. The production declarations match the declared set. Local execution remains unavailable only because this checkout lacks PyYAML; the workflow context documents PyYAML as supplied by shared docs-quality setup, so this is not a PR defect. Findings are unchanged from round 2, so progress is stagnant.
